build_LightfieldModel: build a LightfieldModel from config to predict ray colors using positional encoding and a color network
build_BasisModel: build a BasisModel from config to predict ray colors using learned basis functions and coefficients
build_SubdividedModel: build a SubdividedModel from config to render rays using separate ray and position models with fused outputs
build_LatentSubdividedModel: build a LatentSubdividedModel from config to render rays using a latent model that generates per-ray latent codes
review_BaseLightfieldModel_latent_head: review the BaseLightfieldModel latent_head method that computes positional embeddings for rays with optional latent codes
